pieces.title: Sit Tall
pieces.words: Sit up tall and sit up straight, yes! Shoulders loose and feet are resting.

pieces.title: Ready to Play
pieces.words: Not too near and not too far, good! Arms are level, hands are ready. Sit on the front part of the bench. Now I'm ready, ready to play!

pieces.title: Warm-up: Bubble Hands
pieces.words: Hold a bubble in my right hand, Hold a bubble in my left hand, round and gentle, don't let it pop! round and gentle, don't let it pop!

pieces.title: Warm-up: Heavy Arms
pieces.words: Heavy arm, drop! Heavy arm, drop! Float up and land. Float up and rest.

pieces.title: The Finger Number Song
pieces.words: Two, three, two, three, pointer, middle. Three, two, three, two, middle, pointer.

pieces.title: Pointer and Middle
pieces.words: Bunny, bunny, in the garden, nibbling on a crunchy carrot, two long ears go up to listen, hopping home in time for dinner!

pieces.title: Two Black Keys
pieces.words: Up, up, up high, two black keys sing. Down, down, down low, two black keys hum. Now the middle, two black keys, too. Left hand middle, two black keys, too.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Two-Key Hops
pieces.words: Hop on two keys, hop up high now! Hop on two keys, hop down low now!

pieces.title: Knock, Knock
pieces.words: Knock, knock, who is there? It's me, hi! Knock, knock, who is there? It's me, hi! Come in, come in, come in, my friend!

pieces.title: Canyon Echo
pieces.words: Hello, hello, is someone there? Hello, hello, is someone there? Who is down below? Please tell me! Who is down below? Please tell me!

pieces.title: Balancing Act
pieces.words: One step, two steps, three steps, balance! Wobble, wobble, don't fall down now! High up in the circus, higher, higher, look down, safe on the ground!

pieces.title: Three Black Keys
pieces.words: Three black keys up, three black keys down. Three low keys down, three low keys up. Three high keys up, three high keys down. Three deep keys down, three deep keys up.

pieces.title: Mixed-Up Black Keys
pieces.words: Two keys, two keys, three keys, three keys, two keys, three keys, all black keys play! Two keys, two keys, three keys, three keys, two keys, three keys, all black keys play!

pieces.title: Tick-Tock
pieces.words: Tick, tock, tick, tock, one beat, one beat, Tock, tick, tock, tick, quarter notes, go! keep a steady beat like a clock. Every quarter note gets one beat.

pieces.title: Steady Steps
pieces.words: Walk, walk, walk, walk, step, step, step, step. Big bear marches, stomping feet, boom!

pieces.title: Ding-Dong Bells
pieces.words: Ding, dong, ding, ding, dong, Bong, bong, bong, bong, bong, ding, dong, the bells ring. bong, bong, big bells sing.

pieces.title: Tap and Stretch
pieces.words: Pitter pat, raindrops fall, jump into the puddle, splash! Rumble, boom! Thunder roars! Sun peeks out, a rainbow glows!

pieces.title: Warm-up: Firm Fingertips
pieces.words: Firm fingertips, tap, tap, standing up tall, tap, tap! Left fingertips, tap, tap, standing up tall, tap, tap!

pieces.title: Mouse and Snail
pieces.words: Little mouse runs quickly home. Snail goes slow, slow. Mouse runs around, round and home. Snail is still slow.

pieces.title: Shout and Whisper
pieces.words: Shout it out, loud and clear! Whisper back, soft and low. Here's my voice, strong and loud! Softly now, quiet, shh.

pieces.title: Four Slow Beats
pieces.words: Count to four and hold. Count to four and hold. Long, long note. Low, low sound.

pieces.title: Sleepy Owl
pieces.words: Sleepy little owl says whoo. Sleepy little owl says whoo.

pieces.title: Church Bells
pieces.words: Bells ring out, ring and ring again. Big bells hum, hum and hum again.

pieces.title: D Is in the Middle
pieces.words: C, D, E, E, D, C, D is in the middle. E, D, C, C, D, E, left hand plays them too.

pieces.title: By the Moonlight
pieces.words: By the moonlight, my friend, lend me your pen, please. Let me write a little note to my dear friend.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Pattern Up, Pattern Down
pieces.words: Eagle spreads its wings wide, soaring to the sky high! Gopher digs a deep hole, digging down below ground!

pieces.title: Hot Cross Buns for the Left Hand
pieces.words: Hot cross buns, hot cross buns, one a penny, two a penny, hot cross buns!

pieces.title: Hot Cross Buns
pieces.words: Hot cross buns, hot cross buns, one a penny, two a penny, hot cross buns!

pieces.title: Merrily We Roll Along
pieces.words: Merrily we roll along, roll along, roll along, Merrily we roll along, o'er the deep blue sea.

pieces.title: Busy Bees
pieces.words: Busy, busy bees are buzzing all around the flow'rs. Buzzy, buzzy, bumble, bumble, slowly flying home.

pieces.title: Four White Keys
pieces.words: F, G, A, B, B, A, G, Left hand plays the F and G, F, G, A, B, A, G, F. low F, low G, F.

pieces.title: Up the Stairs
pieces.words: Up the stairs I climb, down the stairs I go. Up the stairs I climb, down the stairs I go.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Bouncing Ball
pieces.words: Bounce it, bounce it, up the staircase, to the top, then bouncing back down, home! Left hand bounces up the staircase, to the top, then bouncing back down, home!

pieces.title: Count the Measures
pieces.words: This is measure one, then two, bar lines in beMeasure five and six and seven, then comes eight.

pieces.title: Marching Band
pieces.words: March, march, left, right, drums go boom! March, march, left, right, stop! Tubas play and horns go toot, tubas play again.

pieces.title: Joyful, Joyful (letter names)
pieces.words: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love; hearts unfold like flow'rs before Thee, op'ning to the sun above.

pieces.title: Three Ways to Play
pieces.words: Softly, softly, shh, shh, now a little louder, now we play it loud!

pieces.title: Neighbour Thumbs
pieces.words: Thumbs are nextdoor neighbours now, Left thumb on B, right on C. Hands are close together here, back down to G. home.

pieces.title: The Musical Alphabet
pieces.words: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, G, F, E, D, C, B, A! Seven letters, that's the list, back again we go, go, go!

pieces.title: Rocking Horse
pieces.words: Rocking, rocking, horsy goes, back and forth and back. giddyup, my horsy, go! Rocking, rocking, Whoa!

pieces.title: Warm-up: Thumb on Middle C
pieces.words: Thumb on its side, down! Stepping back up, home! Back to Middle C!

pieces.title: Swing and Stop
pieces.words: Swing, and swing, and swing, and stop. Swing, and swing, and swing, and stop.

pieces.title: Clock Tower
pieces.words: Bong, the tower, count the chimes with me. Ding, the bell is ringing out the hour.

pieces.title: Sea Waves
pieces.words: Waves roll in, then roll away. Waves roll in, then roll back to the sea.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Softer and Softer
pieces.words: Loud and proud now, big sound, fill the whole room, BOOM! Now so softly, whisper like a little mouse.

pieces.title: Lines and Spaces
pieces.words: Line, space, line, space, line! Space, line, space, line, space. Up we climb the staff, then back down again to

pieces.title: Up and Down the Staff
pieces.words: Up the staff we go! Down the low staff, down! Down the staff we go. Up the low staff, up.

pieces.title: Two Clefs
pieces.words: Treble clef, up high, I sing, Bass clef, down below, I hum, right hand on the upper staff. left hand, lower staff.

pieces.songTitle: High and Low on the Staff
pieces.title: High and Low on the Staff
pieces.words: High up on the treble staff, Low down on the bass clef staff, Middle C is in between, left hand sings it lower too.

pieces.title: Middle C Stomp
pieces.words: Middle C, Middle C, Left thumb on Middle C, march with me, now! stomp, stomp, stomp, stop!

pieces.title: Hello, Treble G
pieces.words: Hello, Treble G, you're on the second line! Left thumb keeps the beat on Middle C too.

pieces.title: C and G Seesaw
pieces.words: Seesaw, up and down, seesaw, seesaw, seesaw, down!

pieces.title: Down to Bass F
pieces.words: Down I go to Bass F, Right thumb plays C. jump, jump, jump, jump, land! Right thumb, Middle C.

pieces.title: F and C Seesaw
pieces.words: Bass F, Middle C, back and forth we go to F.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Drop and Lift
pieces.words: Drop and lift, drop and lift, drop, drop, drop, drop, lift! Drop and lift, drop and lift, drop, drop, drop, drop, lift!

pieces.title: Doorbell
pieces.words: Ding, dong, doorbell rings, Bong, bong, low bell sings, ding, dong, ding, dong! bong, bong, bong, bong!

pieces.title: Chiming Clock
pieces.words: Tick, tock, tick, tock, tock, tock, time for bed. up and down and Down and up and good night, sleep.

pieces.title: Three Friends
pieces.words: Middle C is home. Treble G is high. Bass F is so low. Three friends sing!

pieces.title: Drum Beats
pieces.words: Boom, boom, bang! Boom, boom, bong! Ratatat! Rumpapum! Drums are marching, Down the street and stop! Stop! Bang!

pieces.title: Joyful, Joyful
pieces.words: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love; hearts unfold like flow'rs before Thee, op'ning to the sun above.

pieces.title: The D-E-F Parade
pieces.words: Here comes D and E and F, marching in the band, stepping up and stepping down, then march back to C.

pieces.title: Stepping Up, Stepping Down
pieces.words: Stepping up the stairs we go, step by step and down we go. Up again to reach the top, then we tiptoe home.

pieces.title: Little Bird Steps
pieces.words: Little bird is hopping up, line to space to line again, stepping down the ladder now, step by step back home.

pieces.title: Tin Soldiers
pieces.words: Left, right, left, right, soldiers marching down the little road. Turn around and march back home again, left, right, left, halt!

pieces.title: Four-Beat Band
pieces.words: Four beats in each measure, that's what fourfour means. Quarter notes get one beat, count along with me!

pieces.songTitle: Warm-up: Hop to the Next Key
pieces.title: Warm-up: Hop to the Next Key
Bunny Hops
pieces.words: Hop, bunny, hop! Stop. Hop along to D. Hop along to E. Hop back home to C.

pieces.title: B and C
pieces.words: B and C are neighbors, C and G say hi! step down, step up, home.

pieces.title: Bouncing B
pieces.words: Bouncing ball goes down to B, bouncing, bouncing, C!

pieces.title: Waltzing Bear
pieces.words: One, two, three, dance with me, round and round, go. Twirl around, light as air, now we bow, done.

pieces.title: Warm-up: Flowing Wheels
pieces.words: Round and round go, wheels on the road, flowing along, never stopping.

pieces.title: Rock-a-Bye
pieces.words: Rockabye, dear. Rest your head here. Stars above shine. Sweet dreams now, sleep.

pieces.title: Pony Trot
pieces.words: Trot, trot, trot, go! Trot, trot, trot, whoa! Pony goes down, then back up home.

pieces.title: Bear Walk
pieces.words: Down the mountain, big bear climbs up to the cave. Bear is sleepy, yawning wide, snoring, snoring, shh.

pieces.title: Turtle Walk
pieces.words: Turtle, turtle, walking slowly, slowly, home. In his little shell house, sleepy turtle rests.

pieces.title: Left-Hand Waltz
pieces.words: Left hand starts, then goes up, Right hand joins, dancing too, round we go, round again, round and round, home.

pieces.title: I Call, You Call
pieces.words: I call up high, hi! you call down low, hi! High and low and back again, Low and high and home we go.

pieces.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
pieces.words: Twinkle, twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are! up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky. Twinkle, twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are!

pieces.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
pieces.words: Mary had a little lamb, little lamb, little lamb, Mary had a little lamb, its fleece was white as snow.

pieces.songTitle: When the Saints Go Marching In
pieces.title: When the Saints Go Marching In
pieces.words: Oh, when the saints go marching in, oh, when the saints go marching in, oh Lord, I want to be in that number, when the saints go marching in.

pieces.title: Are You Sleeping?
pieces.words: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping, Brother John, Brother John? Morning bells are ringing, ringing, ding, dang, dong, ding, dang, dong.

pieces.title: Kangaroo Skips
pieces.words: Kangaroo skips, hopping, G and B, space to space. space to space, then home.

pieces.title: Space Hops
pieces.words: D, F, E, D, D, F, G, F, E, D, F, D, C.

pieces.title: Skipping Stones
pieces.words: Skip a stone across the lake, Skip, skip, skip, skip, splash! plip, plop, plip, plop, Ripples spreading splash!

pieces.title: Snowflakes
pieces.words: Snowflakes falling down. Soft and white.

pieces.title: Middle Line D
pieces.words: D on the middle line, skip up and skip down.

pieces.title: D and F Drums
pieces.words: Boom, boom, bap, bap, boom, bap, boom. Snare drum plays a tune. Bap, bap, boom, boom, bap, boom, boom. Snare drum plays and stops.

pieces.title: Down to Bass C
pieces.words: Down, down, down to Bass C, up and down again to C.

pieces.title: C, D, F Dance
pieces.words: Bass C, Bass D, F, D, C. Now the right hand sings!

pieces.title: Bass Parade
pieces.words: Big bass drums go boom, boom, down the long parade. Flutes are playing tweet, tweet, all along the street.

pieces.title: Bass Walk
pieces.words: Climbing up the hill, hill, rolling down again. Left hand plays the low notes too, down and down and home.

pieces.title: Galloping
pieces.words: Gallop, gallop, over hills, up the valley, down the road, trotting, trotting, slowing down, into the barn, home.

pieces.title: Octave Bells
pieces.words: Ding, dong, ding, dong, high, low, C, E, G, E, low, high, low.

pieces.title: Echo Song
pieces.words: I sing high, up so high, now I'm coming down to C.

pieces.title: Bumblebee and Ladybug
pieces.words: Bumblebee flies down so low, Ladybug flies up so high, bumble, bumble, buzz, buzz, buzz, lady, lady, bye!

pieces.title: Trumpet Call
pieces.words: Hear the trumpets call all across the land, hear them playing loud!

pieces.title: Long, Long Lullaby
pieces.words: Hush now, sleep tight dream of stars bright, sleep till dawn light.

pieces.title: Drone Song
pieces.words: Bagpipes playing, humming, humming, low notes holding long and low. Drone goes on and on and on, while we sing along.

pieces.title: Rain, Rain, Go Away
pieces.words: Rain, rain, go away, come again another day, little children want to play.

pieces.title: Stop and Go
pieces.words: Go, go, go! Go, go, go! Stop! Stop! Stop! Stop! Red light, stop! Green light, go! Look both ways, go!

pieces.title: Clap and Rest
pieces.words: Clap, clap, clap, tap, tap, tap, rest between the beats, one, two, three, rest on four, resting keeps the time.
